evals.name: add-feature-large-file
evals.prompt: Додай нову функцію експорту в PDF до мого застосунку (це файл на 2000 рядків), не зламавши те що працює
evals.expected_output: Claude audits first, patches via str_replace, validates before integrating, regression-checks after
assertions: Does grep/view to audit insertion points BEFORE editing
Uses str_replace for targeted patches, NOT full rewrite
Runs syntax/simulation validation BEFORE declaring done
Runs regression check that old features still present
Does NOT rewrite the whole file

evals.name: explicit-surgical-request
evals.prompt: Виправ цей баг хірургічно, економ токени, не переписуй весь файл
evals.expected_output: Claude reads only relevant lines, patches precisely, validates
assertions: Uses view_range to read only relevant section
Does NOT re-read or rewrite entire file

evals.name: validate-before-integrate
evals.prompt: Вбудуй цю нову бібліотеку в застосунок
evals.expected_output: Claude tests the library works BEFORE integrating it into the app
assertions: Tests/verifies library functionality BEFORE wiring into app
Does NOT integrate untested code and hope it works

evals.name: fullwidth-char-trap
evals.prompt: Встав цей React-компонент на 80 рядків у потрібне місце файлу
evals.expected_output: After heredoc insertion, Claude checks for fullwidth chars and validates JSX
assertions: Inserts large block via python heredoc at anchor point
Checks for fullwidth punctuation after insertion

evals.name: sync-duplicate-files
evals.prompt: Я тримаю app.html та index.html ідентичними. Додай фічу X
evals.expected_output: Claude edits one then syncs the copy, keeping them identical
assertions: After editing, syncs the duplicate file
Does NOT let the two files diverge

version_note: evals authored at v1.0.0, revalidated against skill v1.5.2 on 2026-07-03
